work: bounded contact breakup of dynamic clumps

protocol: Serial runs per host, paused kiosk during Picade timing. Desktop timing completed before Yocto build. Audits, hashes, diagnostics, and replay outside update timers. Single timing samples per configuration; small differences are noise. Picade mid-run thermal/frequency observations are included, not a claim that throttling was absent.
scope: Uniform opt-in local chipping of dynamic fragments, gated by pre-solve relative speed and solver impulse/source mass. Default 512 contact scans, 16 chipped cells, one patch attempt per boundary, 0.35-second cooldown. Existing barrage/Spacewars stress scenes produced no impact fractures at yield speed 6; they measure opt-in checking overhead. Actual fracture is exercised by drop/bank fixtures and the rotating-planet integration test.
